decode_example: decode a serialized tf.train.Example proto into nested dict of tensors using TensorFlow backend
decode_example_np: decode a serialized tf.train.Example proto into nested dict of numpy arrays using NumPy backend
serialize_example: encode nested example data dict into serialized tf.train.Example bytes
deserialize_example: deserialize tf.train.Example bytes into TensorFlow tensor dict with optional decoders
deserialize_example_np: deserialize tf.train.Example bytes into NumPy array dict with optional decoders
